description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods. The horizontal axis represents the PEFT method, with labels including “LoRA”, “Prefix-Tuning”, “P-Tuning v2”, “Adapter”, “BitFit”, “IA3”, “Spindle”, and “Bottleneck”, listed in order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each PEFT method is represented by a single, light green bar. The shortest bar corresponds to “BitFit”, with a height of approximately 0.38. The tallest bar corresponds to “Bottleneck”, with a height of approximately 0.88. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
